beats.say: Could you last 18 minutes and three seconds in a UFC cage?
BBC says Alexander Volkanovski holds the longest average fight time in UFC featherweight history.
He is the UFC featherweight champion, and at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi he defends against Movsar Evloev.
So what is on the line?
The BBC says a win would be a record ninth in UFC featherweight title fights.
But Evloev is undefeated in 20 bouts, with a ten-fight winning streak in the UFC, says the BBC.
So a record chase meets an unbeaten run.
